title: Supplemental Allowance Amounts Under Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
Four supplemental allowances apply in the buyer phase of the Real Estate Service Contracts plans. Their amounts are set per plan; an amount of $0.00 means the plan carries no such allowance.

## Allowance schedule (USD)

| Allowance | Basis | Bridgewell Closing Starter | Bridgewell Closing Standard | Bridgewell Closing Plus | Bridgewell Closing Premier | Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Code violation correction needed to complete covered work | per request | 0.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 250.00 |
| Permits covered work requires | per request | 0.00 | 100.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 250.00 |
| Removal of replaced equipment (haul-away) | per request | 0.00 | 75.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 100.00 |
| Refrigerant recovery and recharge | per contract year | 100.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 750.00 | 750.00 | 250.00 |

## Points of reading

- The code violation, permit and haul-away allowances are amounts per service request; the refrigerant allowance is an amount per contract year.
- The Bridgewell Closing Starter plan carries the refrigerant allowance only ($100.00 per contract year); the Bridgewell Closing Standard plan carries no code violation allowance.
- The Bridgewell Closing Premier and Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year plans carry the highest amounts on all four allowances.
